name: pdk-spacebar-gateway-resume-replay
instr:
When a mobile client drops its gateway connection, opcode 6 currently returns `INVALID_SESSION`; dispatches sent while it is away are lost. The API also emits through transient broker subscriptions, so simply buffering a socket's outbound frames cannot recover messages sent during a disconnect.

To close this out:
- For channel `MESSAGE_CREATE` dispatches, make the API's `POST /api/v9/channels/{channel_id}/messages` acknowledgement mean the dispatch is durably recoverable. Writes from separate API processes to one channel have one shared order. While RabbitMQ is unavailable, a call either fails or its acknowledged dispatch remains recoverable after the broker returns.
- A client identifying on gateway A can reconnect on gateway B using opcode 6 with `{token, session_id, seq}`. For a valid session, replay each missed channel message once in shared order with consecutive `s` values following the supplied `seq`, send dispatch `RESUMED` after the replay, and deliver subsequent live messages without duplicates or gaps. Connected clients and resuming clients observe the same channel-message order. This also holds if gateway A is killed; recovery after its failure takes no more than 45 seconds.
- Keep reconnects possible for at least 60 seconds. An unknown session or an unavailable replay range (including a stale sequence) returns opcode 9 with `d: false`, without a partial replay. Ordinary opcode 2 IDENTIFY still yields READY and live `MESSAGE_CREATE` dispatches.
